blocks.text: NEW YORK — Jalen Brunson scored 33 points as the New York Knicks routed the Chicago Bulls 135-105 in the NBA on Wednesday night. OG Anunoby added 18 points and Karl-Anthony Towns finished with 17 points and 12 rebounds as the Knicks won for the fourth time in five games following an 0-3 start to the season.
